abilities.name: Dagger Flurry
abilities.description: Close-range flurry. Melee — ignores cover. The roster's one pure melee cone: nothing fancy, just daggers where you are standing.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description: Teleport to any open square within 4. Ignores walls. The best dodge in the game — on a 2-turn clock.

abilities.name: Veil & Decoy
abilities.description: FREE ACTION — costs no ability, so Wisp can vanish and still Sprint. Vanish for a turn and place a decoy on a square up to 3 away; the decoy shows the enemy team a Wisp that is not there, and dies to any damage. It cannot be placed on an occupied square.

abilities.name: Bola
abilities.description: Thrown bola: 24 damage and Slow for a turn to the FIRST enemy in the line. Wisp's tool for keeping Bastion off her and catching Vex mid-rotation.

ultimate.name: Shadowstep Strike
ultimate.description: Untargetable this turn; appear at the aimed square and strike every enemy within 1 square for 40. The ultimate read — arrives during Dash, before their Blast lands. (100 energy)
